controls.name: Requested Receipt Date
controls.tooltip: Specifies the date that you want the vendor to deliver your order. The field is used to calculate the latest date you can order, as follows: requested receipt date - lead time calculation = order date. If you do not need delivery on a specific date, you can leave the field blank.

controls.name: Expected Receipt Date

controls.name: Sell-to Customer No.

controls.caption: Create New BOM Version
controls.tooltip: Specifies whether to create a new version of the Production BOM with an automatically generated version number.

controls.name: ProductionBOMNoField
controls.caption: Production BOM No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the Production BOM to use.

controls.name: SelectedBOMVersionField
controls.caption: Selected BOM Version
controls.tooltip: Specifies the version of the Production BOM to use.

controls.name: CreateRoutingVersionField
controls.caption: Create New Routing Version
controls.tooltip: Specifies whether to create a new version of the Routing with an automatically generated version number.

controls.name: RoutingNoField
controls.caption: Routing No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the Routing to use.

controls.name: SelectedRoutingVersionField
controls.caption: Selected Routing Version
controls.tooltip: Specifies the version of the Routing to use.

procedures.name: SetTemporaryRecords
procedures.doc: Binds the page list to the provided temporary BOM line records.

procedures.name: GetTemporaryRecords
procedures.doc: Returns the current temporary BOM line records from the page by copying them into the provided variable.

controls.name: Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the BOM line (Item or Production BOM).

controls.name: No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the component item or sub-assembly.

controls.name: Variant Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the variant of the item on the BOM line.

controls.name: Description
controls.tooltip: Specifies a description of the BOM line.

controls.name: Description 2
controls.tooltip: Specifies additional description of the BOM line.

controls.name: Calculation Formula
controls.tooltip: Specifies how to calculate the Quantity per field.

controls.name: Length
controls.tooltip: Specifies the length of the component.

controls.name: Width
controls.tooltip: Specifies the width of the component.

controls.name: Depth
controls.tooltip: Specifies the depth of the component.

controls.name: Weight
controls.tooltip: Specifies the weight of the component.

controls.name: Quantity per
controls.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the component are required per unit of the parent item.

controls.name: Unit of Measure Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit of measure for the BOM line.

controls.name: Scrap %
controls.tooltip: Specifies the scrap percentage for the component.

controls.name: Routing Link Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the routing link code to link this component to a routing operation.

controls.name: Position
controls.tooltip: Specifies the position of the component.

controls.name: Position 2
controls.tooltip: Specifies the second position reference of the component.

controls.name: Position 3
controls.tooltip: Specifies the third position reference of the component.

controls.name: Lead-Time Offset
controls.tooltip: Specifies the lead-time offset for the component.

controls.name: Starting Date
controls.tooltip: Specifies the date from which the BOM line is valid.

controls.name: Ending Date
controls.tooltip: Specifies the last date on which the BOM line is valid.

procedures.name: SetTemporaryRecords
procedures.doc: Binds the page list to the provided temporary routing line records.

procedures.name: GetTemporaryRecords
procedures.doc: Returns the current temporary routing line records from the page by copying them into the provided variable.

controls.name: Operation No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the operation number for the routing line.

controls.name: Previous Operation No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the previous operation number in the routing.

controls.name: Next Operation No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the next operation number in the routing.

controls.name: Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the routing operation (Work Center or Machine Center).

controls.name: No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the work center or machine center.

controls.name: Standard Task Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the standard task code for the operation.

controls.name: Routing Link Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the routing link code to connect this operation to BOM components.

controls.name: Description
controls.tooltip: Specifies a description of the routing operation.

controls.name: Description 2
controls.tooltip: Specifies additional description of the routing operation.

controls.name: Setup Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies the setup time for the operation.

controls.name: Setup Time Unit of Meas. Code
controls.source_expr: Rec."Setup Time Unit of Meas. Code"
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit of measure for the setup time.

controls.name: Run Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies the run time per unit for the operation.

controls.name: Run Time Unit of Meas. Code
controls.source_expr: Rec."Run Time Unit of Meas. Code"
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit of measure for the run time.

controls.name: Wait Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies the wait time after the operation.

controls.name: Wait Time Unit of Meas. Code
controls.source_expr: Rec."Wait Time Unit of Meas. Code"
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit of measure for the wait time.

controls.name: Move Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies the move time after the operation.

controls.name: Move Time Unit of Meas. Code
controls.source_expr: Rec."Move Time Unit of Meas. Code"
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit of measure for the move time.

controls.name: Fixed Scrap Quantity
controls.tooltip: Specifies the fixed scrap quantity for the operation.

controls.name: Scrap Factor %
controls.tooltip: Specifies the scrap factor percentage for the operation.

controls.name: Minimum Process Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies the minimum process time for the operation.

controls.name: Maximum Process Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies the maximum process time for the operation.

controls.name: Concurrent Capacities
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of concurrent capacities for the operation.

controls.name: Send-Ahead Quantity
controls.tooltip: Specifies the send-ahead quantity for the operation.

controls.name: Unit Cost per
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit cost per for the operation.

controls.name: Lot Size
controls.tooltip: Specifies the lot size for the operation.
